items.text: Edward Jones's existing client-serving model is its branch office network, which the firm describes as designed to serve clients through deep, personal relationships and comprehensive advice and planning with financial advisors and client support team professionals located in the communities where clients live and work.
items.quote: The Partnership's branch office model is designed to serve clients through deep, personal relationships and comprehensive advice and planning with financial advisors and client support team professionals ("CSTPs") located in the communities where clients live and work.

items.text: Edward Jones's stated strategic ambition includes continuing to invest in technology to scale its ability to provide financial planning to clients, and to attract and serve new client segments.
items.quote: Continue investing in technology to scale our ability to provide financial planning to our clients • Anticipate clients' needs with the right offering at the right time, now and for generations to come • Attract and serve new client segments

items.text: Edward Jones's initiatives for targeting new clients include High Net Worth (attracting and serving high net worth clients through expanded advice, planning, products and services across multiple service models), Workplace (connecting local business owners and their employees with financial solutions through their workplace), and a new digital platform focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors.
items.quote: These initiatives also include targeting new clients: High Net Worth, focused on attracting and serving high net worth clients through expanded advice, planning, products and services across multiple service models; Workplace, which connects local business owners and their employees with financial solutions through their workplace; and a new digital platform, focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors.

items.text: Edward Jones announced it has taken a minority stake in the personal finance app Quicken, with the stated intention that the investment is a step towards integrating Quicken's personal financial management capabilities more directly into Edward Jones to support its value proposition and advisor conversations with clients; the firm notes it is still determining the actual deployment strategy for how Quicken will be offered to clients and integrated into its internal advisor software platforms.
items.quote: Edward Jones announced that they have taken a minority stake in the personal finance app Quicken, with an explicit intention that the investment is a step towards integrating Quicken's personal financial management capabilities more directly into Edward Jones as a way to support their value proposition and advisor conversations with clients.

items.text: Edward Jones is integrating a technology platform (RPMC, leveraging Aboon Workplace) into its advisor workstation that will cover the entire workplace retirement plan lifecycle, from prospecting to plan servicing, with a prospecting module currently in beta and expected to go live to the broader network early next year.
items.quote: The technology platform, which will be integrated into Edward Jones' advisor workstation, will cover the entire workplace retirement plan lifecycle, from prospecting to plan servicing.
